svg.text: Two side rails 1,550 mm long, outer faces 700 mm apart.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Six cross members 600 mm long between the rails, centred 520, 675

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and 750 mm each side of the middle (the last one flush with the ends).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four legs 192 mm long under the corners, each with a 60 x 60 x 6 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: foot plate and an M12 nut welded on it for a levelling foot.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Top of the frame 273.5 mm from the floor with the feet screwed in

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 13 mm. Weld on a flat table; check the diagonals agree within 2 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Holes, 11 mm: two for each pillow block on the 520 mm members,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 137.5 and 242.5 mm each side of the centre line; four for each post

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: base, 70 mm each side of the centre line on the 675 and 750 members.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: pillow blocks and post bases bolt on top with M10; the brake

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: post bolts to the outer face of a side rail at the middle.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: frame top flat within 2 mm when the feet are set.
